dynamic_candidates.adopted_bound_meaning: the smaller of the analytic quintic supremum and the Lipschitz-refined bound, per constraint and vehicle
dynamic_candidates.candidate_peak_meaning: maximum over the shared S9 candidate grid; the grid alone is not a continuous-time proof and is never recorded as a continuous certificate
dynamic_candidates.confirmation_meaning: a complete success requires both candidate endpoints 0 and 1 and adopted_bound / limit <= 1 + tolerance for every motion phase, vehicle and dynamic constraint; an unconfirmed interval returns UNIFORM_DYNAMIC_UNCONFIRMED and is not publishable, without being reported as a demonstrated physical exceedance
dynamic_candidates.conservative_bound_meaning: per-unit-time supremum from quintic derivative suprema; it is retained as the analytic fallback when no same-phase derivative bound is available
dynamic_candidates.lipschitz_bound_meaning: candidate peak + sup|dq/dt| * h / 2, where sup|dq/dt| is the same-phase full-interval derivative bound and h is the largest adjacent candidate time gap; valid because the nearest candidate is at most h/2 away
